shortDescription: Meta Platforms NASDAQ:META shares rose 0.61% in premarket trading after KeyBanc raised its price target to $900 from $780 while keeping an Overweight rating, citing momentum around the Muse assistant as evidence that consumer-AI sentiment is turning and that Meta has several routes to revenue growt…

children: shares rose 0.61% in premarket trading after KeyBanc raised its price target to $900 from $780 while keeping an Overweight rating, citing momentum around the Muse assistant as evidence that consumer-AI sentiment is turning and that Meta has several routes to revenue growth.

The firm lifted its 2027 revenue forecast to $313.8 billion, up 23% year-over-year, and its 2028 forecast to $378.7 billion, up 21%, figures it pegged 3% and 4% above consensus. Its earnings estimates followed, $35.09 for 2027, about 4% above the Street, and $40.50 for 2028, roughly 1% above. The $900 target is set at 22.2x KeyBanc's 2028 earnings estimate. KeyBanc also pointed to Meta's August settlement of the Social Addiction trial and the September Muse launch as having cleared overhang and firmed up confidence in the product cycle.
KeyBanc said it will watch Meta Connect, which runs September 23-24, for signs of how Meta is courting developers and building monetization paths around its AI products.

title: Meta Draws a $900 Call as KeyBanc Models Past Consensus
